title: Joint Force Repels Second RSF Encirclement Attempt on Bir Saliba in a Week
detail: The RSF launched a second attempt in less than a week to seize Bir Saliba, West Darfur, on August 8, 2026, attempting to encircle the Joint Force position from multiple directions. Regional governor Minni Arko Minnawi said the RSF 'bet on surprise to break through defenses,' but the attack was again repelled by Joint Force fighters and allied SAF units, following the failed August 4 assault in which RSF commander Mahdi Adam ('Jebel Moon') was killed. The area, roughly 30km north of el-Geneina, remains the RSF's last major stronghold in West Darfur.

title: Over 6,650 Displaced from 11 Villages in Sirba Region, West Darfur
detail: More than 6,650 people were displaced from 11 villages in the Sirba region of West Darfur amid renewed RSF offensive activity near el-Geneina, according to figures reported on August 8, 2026. The displacement adds to West Darfur's already severe humanitarian burden, part of a nationwide total exceeding 13 million displaced since the war began in April 2023.

title: SPLM-N (al-Hilu) Detains Six More Aid Workers in Kauda, South Kordofan
detail: The Sudan People's Liberation Movement-North (al-Hilu faction) detained six humanitarian workers in Kauda, South Kordofan State, on August 8, 2026, and took them to an undisclosed location — two days after detaining four other aid workers from the Smartin organization. The six were identified as John Omar, Moza Younis, Najah Koko, Dr. Mirghani Adam, Akhnouq Ramadan, and Nasri Musa, representing Answer the Call, Smartin, and the International Rescue Committee. The detentions came amid clashes between SPLM-N forces and the Otoro tribe in the Kauda area; Otoro tribal chief Koko Al-Daqir called on authorities to halt the detentions and return to legal procedures.
